summary: Independent Luna re-review of PR #156 exact head bd5dbccd701c7ace526305d1db2fbcd1c4588fa2 found two remaining blockers: GitHub check/run metadata does not prove actual publisher dispatch inputs/cap failure, and coordinator-only concurrency does not reserve release/ref state against other writers.
validation: All referenced runs/checks are now dereferenced, but workflow-run API omits dispatch inputs
GitHub Actions app identity does not cryptographically bind check metadata to the exact publisher tuple
A signed/attested failure record must bind full tuple, run attempt, measured archive size, and cap
Second state read reduces but does not close the release-shell/tag TOCTOU window
Automatic-release concurrency does not cover publish-release or manual/API writers
blockers: Add and verify trusted OIDC/Sigstore publisher failure attestation before retirement
Add a repository-wide reservation/coordination protocol enforced by every automated release-shell/ref writer with atomic final checks
next_action: Use the final code loop to replace check-only proof with signed exact failure evidence and implement a shared fail-closed release-state reservation protocol with adversarial tests.

issues.title: Publisher failure proof is not cryptographically bound to actual dispatch tuple
